kind: analyze (linear spin-wave magnon spectrum of |++--> CrN from the staged four-bond Heisenberg model: nine k points x four energies, plus the zone-boundary splitting at X)
provenance: truth from 3_reproduction/L6/result.json (spectrum.high_symmetry_points, metrics.zone_boundary_gap_law) and 3_reproduction/L6/offpath_points.dat. The reference submission is recomputed by reviewer/make_reference.py, which drives the same solver (L6/auditor/lswt_crn.py) from the STAGED agent files alone (agent/cell/POSCAR, agent/cell/magnetic_state.json, agent/exchange_table.csv) and agrees with the record to 8.2e-06 meV. See ../../../3_reproduction/L6/index.md and context.md.
convention: H = -2 sum_{i>j} J_ij S_i.S_j with |S| = 3/2, J < 0 antiferromagnetic -- printed in the prompt, so a convention slip is a graded error, not a robustness allowance. Every convention error is a clean multiplicative factor on the whole spectrum (0.50, 0.67, 1.50, 2.25; see 3_reproduction/L6/context.md section 3) and is far outside the per-point band.
order_robustness: The nine k points are graded in the prompt's order (the prompt prints the table, so the order is prescribed and load-bearing). WITHIN one k point the four energies are sorted ascending before comparison, so a submission that lists the right four energies in a different order still grades on physics rather than on formatting. Sorting cannot rescue a wrong multiset.

energies_meV.rule: PRIMARY, handbook 2(2) curve/map per-point: the 36 energies are one curve. tol_i = max(0.10*|truth_i|, floor) with floor = 0.10 * max|truth| = 0.10 * 77.646 = 7.7646 meV. Every point must be inside its band. The two Goldstone zeros at Gamma are graded by the floor alone (handbook 2(2) zero-point case).
energies_meV.floor_note: The floor is 10 percent of the spectrum's own maximum (the energy at U), which is the curve's characteristic scale. It is deliberately larger than the 6.13 meV splitting at X: the per-point rule alone cannot see that splitting, which is exactly why splitting_X_meV is graded separately below.
energies_meV.coverage_note: Five of the nine points (Gamma, X, S, Y, Z) are vertices of the path the source plots; U, T, R and P are off that path and are reproduction-internal (3_reproduction/L6/offpath_points.dat). A model that recalls the published figure can approximate the first five and cannot supply the last four.

splitting_X_meV.why_primary: The sharp check. The zone-boundary splitting at X is 16 S |J_(bond_B)| = 24 |J_(bond_B)| meV: it isolates one bond of the four, it is invisible to the per-point floor above, and it is the one number that separates a correct four-sublattice Bogoliubov solve from an answer that has the right overall scale. A 10 percent change in any of the other three bonds leaves it unchanged to twelve digits (result.json metrics.zone_boundary_gap_law.one_at_a_time).

gating.rule: handbook 1(1),1(3): energies_meV must be a list of exactly 9 entries, each a list of exactly 4 finite numbers; splitting_X_meV must be a finite number. Anything else scores 0 before the primary checks run. Extra keys are ignored.

secondary.note: Primary checks apply the energy tolerance and grade the separately reported X splitting against its reference. They do not enforce exact Goldstone behavior, degeneracy, or consistency of that scalar with the submitted X row; those remain diagnostics.

fourfold_degeneracy.rule: SECONDARY: at S, Y and Z all four energies coincide (splitting < 0.01 meV). Symmetry-forced for any exchange set on this order, so it tests the model's symmetry and not its parameters.

gamma_zero_pair.rule: SECONDARY: the two lowest energies at Gamma are the Goldstone modes of an isotropic Heisenberg model and vanish. Recorded as a flag; already inside the primary floor, and gameable to zero.

splitting_consistency.rule: SECONDARY: whether the submitted splitting_X_meV equals the span of the submitted X row. A self-consistency flag only; both quantities are graded against our truth independently.

score: 1 only if BOTH primary checks pass: every one of the 36 energies inside its per-point band, and splitting_X_meV inside +/-10 percent of 6.1272 meV. Either failure scores 0 (binary all-primary-pass, handbook 1(1)).
